d:
Toovar Dana Dhekhra – Crispy, golden bites made with fresh tavar dana, a blend of flours, sesame seeds, jaggery and aromatic spices. Best enjoyed with green chutney!
Toovar Dana Puri – Soft and flavourful dough made with boiled toovar dana, ginger and green chillies, rolled into small puris and fried until golden.
Crispy Kand – Grated purple yam seasoned with spices, cooked until crisp and served with a delicious creamy dip.
Air-Fried Turnip Fries – Golden turnip fries tossed in a tangy, spicy seasoning mix and served with refreshing Greek yoghurt.
